title: Catalyst App Config JSON
description: Catalyst AppSail configuration file for ZCatalyst-CLI

build_path.description: Path where the AppSail's build artifacts are located

env_variables.description: Environment variables to be used in the AppSail

memory.description: Memory configuration of the AppSail in MB

preserve.description: Script to be executed before starting the AppSail during Catalyst Serve

postserve.description: Script to be execute after closing the AppSail during Catalyst Serve

predeploy.description: Script to be executed before packing the AppSail artifacts during Catalyst deploy

postdeploy.description: Script to be execute after deploying the packed AppSail to development environment

platform.description: Platform to deploy the java AppSail

catalyst_auth.description: configuration to choose whether to enable Catalyst Authentication for the AppSail

login_redirect.description: Url to redirect the user after successful authentication
